locate.sentence: The city's independent budget office estimates the measure would add $186 per year to the tax bill of a median-priced home, a figure opponents called "regressive and punishing." locate.sentence: It is the peculiar misfortune of our age — an age of telegraphs, of penny papers, and of railway time-tables — that the faculty of attention, which our grandfathers exercised as naturally as they breathed, must now be cultivated with the deliberate care one bestows upon a delicate orchid; for the mind of the modern reader, solicited at every hour by a hundred trifling novelties, has grown so accustomed to flitting that it can scarcely be persuaded to alight.

locate.sentence: The remedy lies rather in the discipline of election: in choosing, from among the innumerable claimants upon our notice, the few that deserve it, and in attending to those few with the whole force of the mind.
